summary.text: Avram Hicks is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 76 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Anne Donworth.
Hicks works in property management and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a conservative leader, Christian, husband and father.

paragraphs.text: Avram Hicks was born in Glasgow, Kentucky, and earned a high school diploma from Penn Foster High School.
His career experience includes working in property management.
The Republican primary for the seat, scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled, and Hicks advanced to the general election without appearing on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hicks listed ending the state income tax, school choice in which the money follows the child, and crime and the death penalty as his three key campaign messages.
He named education, crime and homelessness as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
He said the first bill he would introduce would allow the firing squad as a method of execution when lethal injection drugs are not available.
